verdict.rationale: Dialpad's own docs say calling and messaging share one app and one set of customer data. Contact records are tied to associated call recordings and AI data, which suggests calls and texts are unified around a contact. The evidence never explicitly describes per-contact threading of calls and texts, shared notes, or team-wide visibility of history, so support is thin. missing for 10: explicit per-contact threaded timeline of calls and SMS, contact notes, documented team-wide sharing or visibility of contact history, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees

citations.quote: calling, messaging, meetings, and contact center work share one app and one set of customer data rather than being packaged from separate products.
Call recordings and AI data associated with these contacts are also removed.
